title: Demo · SaaS market entry — Germany vs France
query: Should a B2B SaaS company prioritize Germany or France for its first European market entry, given an 18-month horizon and 12-headcount cap?

intake_questions.text: What is the target ICP (industry, company size)?
What is the budget for the entry initiative?
What compliance posture is required (GDPR, sector-specific)?

intake_answers.text: Mid-market B2B SaaS, 100-1000 employees, retail and logistics verticals.
$2.5M for the first 18 months, headcount capped at 12.
GDPR compliance required; data residency preferred but not mandatory.
